blocks.html: User Adoption is the extent to which customers actively and consistently use a product or service after purchase, reflecting its usability, relevance, and perceived value.

User adoption is a key indicator of product success. Strong adoption shows that customers find value in the solution, while low adoption may signal onboarding issues, poor usability, or weak product-market fit.
User adoption is commonly measured through:
Businesses track adoption to improve customer success and reduce churn.
A project management platform sees strong user adoption when teams log in daily, collaborate regularly, and use multiple core features.
User Adoption measures how actively customers use a product after purchase and reflects the real value they receive from it.
Turn customers into loyal users. MarketJoy helps businesses improve user adoption through stronger onboarding, engagement, and retention strategies.
